content.value: A series of test on a ceramic component indicate that 25% of the samples fail at stresses below 207 MPa, whereas, only 10% fail at stresses below 198 MPa. Determine the Weibull Modulus and the maximum allowable stresses if only 1 failure per 1000 specimens can be tolerated.
